implementation_notes: The createMethodDictionary operation would need to be added to JsonBootstrapExecutor
This operation would create a dictionary with the specified capacity using VM primitives
The dictionary would be installed in slot 1 (methodDict) of the target class
Phase 2 and Phase 3 would then have properly sized dictionaries to work with
This eliminates the need for dictionary replacement during method installation
benefits: No more 'Dictionary full' errors during method installation
Proper method counts in pretty printer output
Better performance - no dictionary replacement needed
Cleaner separation of concerns - sizing happens during class creation
Easier to maintain - sizes are specified declaratively
